name: mimu-geonode-myanmar-river-network-250k-scale
notes:
Myanmar national river network(lines).
Data from the Digital Chart of the World. Digitization revised by MIMU at 1:250,000 scale.

This dataset was mainly digitized at 1:250’000 scale. Place names are in line with the general cartographic practice to reflect the names of such places as designated by the government concerned.
